results.note: Anthropic's release dated 18 Nov 2026 says it priced its IPO of 980 million Class A shares at $83.00 per share; trading on Nasdaq as ANT began 19 Nov.
Priced on 18 Nov 2026 at $83.00 per share, above the $78 top of the $70–78 range.

The state visit took place on 18 Nov, but Ambassador Romualdez said nothing was signed and no joint statement was released (TNND, citing Reuters); the White House statements list shows Quad and US–Thailand joint texts but no US–Philippines one.
ONS bulletin of 18 Nov 2026: CPI rose by 3.6% in the 12 months to October 2026, up from 3.5% in September.

NSS press release of 18 Nov 2026: in Vol 11/2026 the election senate granted Černý's complaint and declared the vote in both rounds in the whole of district 51 invalid, after a review of ballots from precincts with high invalid-vote shares.
Cenový věstník částka 126 of 18 Nov 2026 sets the maximum diesel price for 19 Nov at 45,68 Kč s DPH per litre (petrol 40,22).
Senate roll call 268 on 18 Nov 2026 at 1:23 PM: motion to invoke cloture re H.R.2347 (the bill itself) agreed to, 65–31; the bill passed on 19 Nov.

Antara, 18 Nov 2026: Bank Indonesia raised the BI-Rate by 25 bp to 6.00% after its November Board of Governors meeting (deposit facility 5.25%, lending facility 6.75%); also reported by Xinhua and The Star.
Per AFP (via Quartz FR, also CNews), the Senate adopted the PLFSS 2027 at first reading in the solemn vote of 18 Nov 2026 by 201 votes to 124; senat.fr scrutin pages refuse the reader.
Target's Q3 2026 release (8-K Ex. 99, 18 Nov) reports GAAP and Adjusted EPS of $2.65, including $0.50 of tariff-refund benefits that Target leaves inside Adjusted EPS.
ČTK: according to the Office of the Government's statement on Wednesday 18 Nov, 17 applications were received (Babiš said 16 on 19 Nov); either way at least 5, and no deadline extension was reported.
